answer.summary_why: Blend Bengali traditions with Rajasthani elegance, focusing on fish‐centric cuisine and alpana décor while keeping the large guest list smooth.

ideas.title: Alpana‐style floor art

ideas.why: Meets the alpana decor request and adds a unique visual element.

ideas.title: Fish feast reception
ideas.description: Feature a live ‘Machher Jhol’ station and assorted fried fish platters alongside classic Indian dishes.
ideas.why: Fish is essential for a Bengali wedding and creates a memorable culinary highlight.

ideas.title: Bengali folk music interludes

ideas.description: Serve ‘Aam Panna’ or ‘Jaljira’ at the venue entrance for guests arriving early.

answer.summary_why: Focus on Tamil Brahmin traditions, vegetarian banana‐leaf service and authentic nadaswaram music while keeping the large Jaipur wedding elegant and on budget.
